_comment: Source of truth for the required status checks on main. Apply a change with
and read the live ruleset back afterwards.
Two checks, the Git Crafter shape Fusion Canyon also uses: ci / ci-ok, the one verdict of
.github/workflows/ci.yml (Git Crafter ci-standard.yml), and DCO. ci / ci-ok reports on every
pull request, because ci.yml has no paths filter and ci-ok runs with if: always().
integration_id 15368 is GitHub Actions, so only an Actions run can satisfy the ci context.
Only the required_status_checks rule lives here. The org ruleset 'Protect
default branches' already blocks deletion and force-push and requires a
pull request, so repeating those rules here would add nothing.
No approval is required: outside contributors cannot merge. Every merge follows
the house merging skill: a fresh-context review, then a merge at the literal
name: main: required checks
